facts.summary: SRC approved opening third cohort, no significant toxicities, early PK/PD consistent · Phase 1 · TTX-MC138 in metastatic solid cancers · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the Safety Review Committee (SRC) monitoring its Phase 1 clinical trial has unanimously approved opening of the third cohort of patients based on its favorable review of Cohort 2 safety data.
evidence.safety: No significant safety or dose limiting toxicities have been reported.
